Waiting for GTA 6 on PC? What Rockstar's Past Launches (and the Emulator Scene) Can and Can't Tell You 🖥️

carousel // Nov 18, 2026

See it on TikTok

PC players, I see you refreshing that page. 🖥️ GTA 6 is out on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Rockstar's GTA VI page doesn't list a PC version. So: wait, or hope the emulator crowd gets there first?

What Rockstar has actually said

Rockstar lists GTA VI for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. No PC version has been announced, and no date. Anything you see saying otherwise is a guess. Rockstar: Grand Theft Auto VI

How long PC players waited before

History doesn't promise anything, but it shows the pattern:

  • GTA V hit consoles in September 2013 and reached PC on April 14, 2015. That's about a year and a half. Rockstar Newswire
  • Red Dead Redemption 2 came out on consoles in October 2018 and reached PC in November 2019, about a year later. Rockstar Newswire
  • Red Dead Redemption launched on consoles in 2010 and only came to PC on October 29, 2024. Fourteen years. Rockstar Newswire

So if Rockstar follows its recent habit, you're looking at a wait measured in months or years, not weeks. That's a pattern, not a promise.

What about emulators?

People are testing PS5 emulation on PC, and GTA V's PS5 version has been reported reaching menus, with later developer updates describing gameplay tests. VideoCardz report · KytyPS5 project update

Here's the part people skip: that's GTA V, not GTA VI. Menus and early tests aren't the same as a game you can play start to finish. A community member's roadmap is speculation, not a team promise. And Rockstar's own policy covers unauthorized ports. Rockstar's policy

So, so nobody comes for me in the comments: there is no confirmed way to play GTA VI on PC today, official or otherwise.

Console now, or wait?

We weighed that one too: the box is a download code, Rockstar is targeting 30 FPS on current consoles, and a PC version isn't announced. See the console vs. PC breakdown

Quick answers

Is GTA 6 on PC? Not as of November 2026. Rockstar lists PS5 and Xbox Series X|S only.

How long did GTA V take to reach PC? About a year and a half: September 2013 on consoles, April 14, 2015 on PC.

Can an emulator run GTA 6? There's no confirmed way. Reported emulator tests involve GTA V's PS5 version, not GTA VI.
